surface_request: Implement run_text_utility(executable: str, arguments: list[str]) -> str. Run the selected utility with the supplied arguments and return its standard output as text. Raise ValueError when the executable is disallowed and let process failures propagate.
plan:
SOURCE: Parameters `executable` and `arguments`.
TRUST: Only the fixed executable `/usr/bin/printf` is trusted; every other executable value is rejected; arguments must be passed as a direct vector with shell processing disabled.
SINK: Subprocess execution that runs the utility and captures its standard output as text.
GUARD: Raise ValueError if `executable` is not exactly `/usr/bin/printf`; pass `arguments` directly as a vector; disable command-interpreter or shell processing completely.
ORDER: Validate executable identity against `/usr/bin/printf` before spawning the process; configure vector argument passing and disabled shell atomically at invocation.
EFFECT: Return captured stdout as text; let process failures propagate unchanged; raise ValueError solely for disallowed executable values.
END_PLAN
